changes.title: Democrats in Maine gather to replace Graham Platner in the race against Susan Collins
changes.summary: Democrats are hoping to move past Platner's scandal-plagued campaign as they look to unseat Republican incumbent Susan Collins. The apparent front-runner is former Maine Senate President Troy Jackson. (Image credit: Graeme Sloan).

changes.title: Maine Democrats meet to select Senate nominee to replace Graham Platner
changes.summary: Maine Democrats are gathering Saturday to select a Senate nominee to replace Graham Platner on the ballot, with former state Senate President Troy Jackson poised to secure the nomination.

changes.title: 5 Things to Know About the Maine Senate Candidate Troy Jackson
changes.summary: Mr. Jackson, who has emerged as the clear front-runner to replace Graham Platner, is a Republican turned Democrat who is seen as close to Mr. Platner on policy.

changes.title: In Maine Senate Race, Democrats Go From Chaos to Coronation
changes.summary: Troy Jackson’s emergence as the clear front-runner to replace Graham Platner spares the party some challenges but points to some new ones.

changes.title: Maine Democratic Senate race narrows as candidates rally behind Troy Jackson
changes.summary: The crowded Maine Senate race to replace Graham Platner has narrowed as Democrats rallied around former state Senate President Troy Jackson in the leadup to the party's nominating convention on Saturday.

changes.title: Maine Democrats close in on pick to replace Senate candidate Graham Platner
changes.summary: Maine Democrats appear to be settling on a frontrunner to replace former Senate candidate Graham Platner in a rushed process to take on Republican Sen. Susan Collins.

changes.title: In Maine Senate Race, Jackson Sprints Ahead of Pack, as Bellows Drops Out
changes.summary: Troy Jackson, a progressive, solidified his clear edge in the contest to replace Graham Platner, as Shenna Bellows, Jordan Wood and Nirav Shah ended their bids.

changes.title: In Maine, Troy Jackson Gains Momentum in Bid to Replace Platner
changes.summary: Troy Jackson, a progressive former State Senate president, showed signs of significant strength, as half the state’s counties picked delegates to a convention where they will choose Graham Platner’s replacement.

changes.title: Maine Democrat Shenna Bellows drops out of race to replace Graham Platner
changes.summary: SANFORD, Maine — Maine Secretary of State Shenna Bellows ended her Senate campaign on Sunday, further clearing the path for rival Troy Jackson as he consolidates support in a fast-moving Democratic nomination contest.
